scope: User requested the whole display range in both supplied books, including plain poster faces, scripts and blackletter.
notes: This is a work ledger, not a release manifest or a claim that every face is complete.
Page-level survey and captions identify candidates. Some caption groups still need subdivision or comparison before separate families are created.
Existing ornament/initial extraction is not equivalent to a complete text font. Incomplete decorative alphabets remain candidates for future companion drawings.
Boston PDF numbering equals archive leaf numbering here because the colour card leaf 0 is excluded. Baltimore PDF page is archive leaf + 1. Use retained page maps rather than a universal offset.

Nine families have completed source/outline/PDF/PNG and desktop/mobile browser review, proportion checks and isolated byte-identical rebuilds. Unlisted families remain pending; this ledger does not treat an extracted specimen word as a finished font.
